message: ほわちゃっ!!

name: Synn
message: 「Looking at it again like this, Asukai Shrine really is huge...」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming to pray alone every now and then is nice, too. Standing here in the shrine grounds gives me such a refreshing feeling.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is here too, ya know.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't count, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh, the Demon Lord and I are of one mind and body. I see right through everything you're thinking. Scouting out the scene in broad daylight--truly worthy of the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「The scene?」

name: Paqy
message: 「On the night of the festival, you're planning to drag that naginata chick into some dark corner around here and do this and that to her, aren't ya?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Thinking of turning a sacred priestess into a meat slave, I'm in awe of ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「...If you keep making wild accusations like that, I'll put you up for adoption at Misa's house, okay?」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Higiiiiiiiii--!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「*Slump!* Blub, blub, blub...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You hate it enough to faint?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, he'll wake up at dinnertime anyway, so whatever... Now then, time to make a wish.」

name: Synn
message: 「The dream I want to grasp is--」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh? Is that not Synn-dono? Have you come to pray for the success of the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, something like that.」

name: Shio
message: 「How admirable of you.」

name: Shio
message: 「What say you? Since you have come all this way, would you care to stay for a cup of tea?」

name: Shio
message: 「I have come into possession of some fine tea leaves, you see. If you do not mind my own brewing.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, I'll gladly take you up on your offer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Black tea for Misa, and Japanese tea for Shio-chan, huh... You two really are alike in some ways. You're so close, you're just like real sisters.」

name: Shio
message: 「It pleases me to hear you say so. However, Synn-dono, allow me to correct you on one point.」

name: Shio
message: 「My older sister and I consider ourselves true sisters. We are cousins, so we are practically bound by blood.」

name: Shio
message: 「Furthermore, it would be no exaggeration to say that we grew up together under the same roof.」

name: Shio
message: 「For over ten years now, my sister has frequently stayed at the Asukai estate.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That long ago!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Her parents of the Cristelis family were terribly busy. Being on close terms with them, our household gladly took my sister in.」

name: Shio
message: 「Though, at first, I could not bring myself to call her 'Older Sister'...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not? Even though you two are so close.」

name: Shio
message: 「I felt as though my father and mother were going to be stolen away from me.」

name: Shio
message: 「...During her very first stay, I went to peek into the parlor.」

name: Shio
message: 「There, a pretty child with long hair was politely greeting my father and mother and expressing her gratitude, using difficult words that I had never even heard before.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hold on a second.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds just like Misa, but... that's totally unnatural for a kid!」

name: Shio
message: 「It is just as you say. Though she was still of a tender age, my sister was overly considerate and drew a line between herself and others.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me, with you too, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「No, with me, she created no distance whatsoever. Never boasting of being a quarter-foreigner, she treated me as a true friend.」

name: Shio
message: 「...That is precisely why it was all the more frustrating. I feared that Father and Mother held my sister in higher regard than myself.」

name: Shio
message: 「Unlike my sister, my hair was short and as black as a crow's...」

name: Synn
message: 「That has nothing to do with it.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hehe, back when my sister was just a little thing, she said the exact same thing.」

name: Shio
message: 「And then...」

name: Shio
message: 「And then, she chopped right through the beautiful hair she had taken such care to grow out and shouted, 'I challenge you!!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you accept her challenge?」

name: Shio
message: 「Naturally, for I was inexplicably furious.」

name: Shio
message: 「Though, what exactly it was that provoked my anger remains unclear to me even now...」

name: Synn
message: 「Who won?」

name: Shio
message: 「I have forgotten.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Really?」

name: Shio
message: 「Let us say that is the truth.」

name: Shio
message: 「For many years after that, I competed against Elder Sister in various contests. On occasion, I even managed to claim victory, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good grief... Misa's been picking fights with anyone and everyone since she was a kid, huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay!」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono, that alone is utterly impossible.」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister only challenges those whose abilities she truly acknowledges.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, now that she has surpassed me by far, we still associate just as we always have, yet she never breathes so much as a word about competing.」

name: Shio
message: 「I can no longer hope for the golden opportunity to learn from defeat and grow...」

name: Shio
message: 「And so afterward, by the time her hair had grown longer than before, Elder Sister already boasted absolute invincibility.」

name: Shio
message: 「However...」

name: Shio
message: 「At Ryuusei Academy, you appeared, Synn-dono. You know the rest.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really think of myself as competing with Misa, though?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, in other words, Elder Sister will not be able to win for the foreseeable future.」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall humbly watch over what becomes of the two of you.」

name: Shio
message: 「To tell the truth, I am feeling just a tad jealous of you, Synn-dono. To be able to compete with Elder Sister is truly enviable.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Shio-chan. Even without competing directly, don't you think you can grow just by watching Misa?」

name: Synn
message: 「The way I see it, Misa is competing with herself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Someone who can't beat themselves can never beat anyone else.」

name: Shio
message: 「How odd? I was under the impression that I had seen through to Elder Sister's self-mastery and respected it long ago, yet...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, this will not do. Conversing with you, Synn-dono, makes me... feel more and more frustrated.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, saying that with a big smile on your face.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a really good kid, Shio-chan. Always looking out for Misa like that.」

name: Shio
message: 「T-To be praised by a gentleman... I am quite flustered, indeed.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh! I have yet to serve any tea. I shall go brew some at once.」

name: Shio
message: 「I hear that Sister treats you to black tea day and night, Synn-dono. I lack confidence in whether my Japanese tea will suit your palate, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「Less of a treat and more like Misa's forcing me to study black tea. She says she can't stand watching me drink watered-down leftover brews.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that respect, Japanese tea is great!」

name: Synn
message: 「You know? If you just keep re-steeping leftover leaves of any kind of tea over and over, before you know it, it turns into hojicha.」

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about getting twice the flavor out of a single batch.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I see. Now I understand how Sister feels.」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall brew some authentic Japanese tea for you, Synn-dono. Please wait for about an hour.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That long!?」

name: Shio
message: 「The real thing takes time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, oh! I just remembered an urgent errand--」

name: Shio
message: 「...Forgive my rudeness.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeek!?」

name: Shio
message: 「You will learn the taste of authentic tea. See that you do not go home.」

name: Synn
message: 「She pinned me to the ground with a naginata!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan might actually be even more competitive than Misa... S-Scary.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I pull the naginata out before Shio-chan gets back, I can still escape. Paqy, help me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Packyyyyyyyy!!」
